title: Unilateral morning glory disc anomaly in a patient with prenatal Zika virus exposure.
ehr_evidence: A complete ophthalmological exam was performed. Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and computed tomography (CT) were performed and were remarkable for a base of skull encephalocele and callosal dysgenesis.
summary: Case report describing a 3-year-old male with confirmed prenatal Zika virus exposure who presented with unilateral morning glory disc anomaly and associated midline brain defects.
key_findings: Visual acuity was 20/200 in the right eye (OD) and 20/20 in the left eye (OS).
Neuroimaging revealed a base of skull encephalocele and callosal dysgenesis.
data_availability_statement: All data generated or analyzed during this study are included in this manuscript.
